svg.title: AgentVault physical architecture
svg.desc: Default deployment: shared edge, replicated runtime, independent state Control boundaries separate the browser, AuthGuard, business applications, AgentVault, external services, and infrastructure. Connections are numbered per invocation flow; abbreviations and sequence prefixes are explained in the footer.
svg.text: Default deployment: shared edge, replicated runtime, independent state
Implemented boundaries · standard HTTP SDKs · authoritative SQL · external settlement

g.text: Default: 2 combined-role replicas · one binary per Pod
Shared SQL ports · reconciliation · expiry · balance sync
PostgreSQL / Redis / Jaeger default on; configured external endpoints can replace them.
SQLite is a single-process local-volume option, not a shared replica database.
Role model: --role all is the default; --role payer / --role payee allow separate processes. Compose defaults to one combined backend.
Configure production TLS at the edge; Compose publishes HTTP :8080. AgentVault does not host business MCP/A2A servers or embed a settlement provider.
Sequence IDs: A = access; P = outbound payment; I = inbound collection; R = recovery; B = bootstrap / projection.
Independent calls: D1 = SQL; C1 = cache; T1 = telemetry; O1 = private operations; X1 = configured external infrastructure.
Numbers follow each flow, not one global clock. Replies return on the same path; P1 repeats with the authorized Credential.
Solid arrow: call; reply uses the same path
Boundary boxes indicate ownership, not a hop
